test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 3(5)/(9) years at the rate of 2.7% per annuin is 2,808. What will be the amount payable on the same sum at the rate of 9.2% per annun simple interest in 5(2)/(3)years?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Calculate **Effective Rate** for the first case: (32/9) × 2.7% = 9.6%.

Given 9.6% of **Principal** = 2,808 ⇒ 1% of **Principal** = 2808 ÷ 9.6 = 292.5.

New **Effective Rate** for 5 2/3 years = (17/3) × 9.2% = 156.4/3 % ≈ 52.133%.

New **Amount Percentage** = 100% + 52.133% = 456.4/3 %.

Amount = 292.5 × (456.4 ÷ 3) = 97.5 × 456.4 = 44499.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹44,499.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial **Time** (T₁) = 3 5/9 = 32/9 years

Initial **Rate** (R₁) = 2.7% p.a.

Initial **Simple Interest** (SI₁) = ₹2,808

New **Time** (T₂) = 5 2/3 = 17/3 years

New **Rate** (R₂) = 9.2% p.a.

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60ea1b02a105343f3ddb84ef39ca58104f745b3c98c374379250fb3cfe5a2a69.png] 

⇒ 2808 = (P × 2.7 × 32/9) ÷ 100

⇒ 2808 = (P × 0.3 × 32) ÷ 100

⇒ 2808 = (P × 9.6) ÷ 100

⇒ P = (2808 × 100) ÷ 9.6 = ₹29,250

⇒ New SI = (29250 × 9.2 × 17/3) ÷ 100

⇒ New SI = (292.5 × 9.2 × 17) ÷ 3

⇒ New SI = 97.5 × 9.2 × 17 = ₹15,249

⇒ Amount = 29,250 + 15,249 = ₹44,499

**∴ The correct answer is ₹44,499.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Interest Percentage

The total interest earned is the product of the **Rate** (R) and **Time** (T). Total Interest % = R × T.

Amount in Simple Interest

The **Amount** payable is calculated as A = P(1 + RT/100), where P is the **Principal**.

Rule of Consistency

In **Simple Interest**, the interest remains constant for each year on the original **Principal** sum regardless of the duration.
